2. Review the categories **Temporary files**, **Large or unused files**, **Files synced to the cloud**, and **Unused apps**, then choose the items you want to remove.
3. Click the **Clean up** button in each section.
If you upgraded Windows fewer than 10 days ago, your previous version appears as a deletable system file. My hands shake a lot from my medicine, so tapping tiny buttons is hard. What is the shortest way to get the Uber app on my iPhone?

Here is the shortest way to get Uber on your iPhone.
1. Open the **App Store**.
2. Tap the **Search** tab and look for Uber.
3. Tap the price or **Get** button.
4. If asked, enter your Apple Account password to finish the download.
5. Confirm the purchase by double-clicking the side button on your iPhone. With Face ID, glance at the device. With Touch ID, rest your finger on the button.
If you see the **Open** button instead, Uber is already downloaded.
